info.title: SDKWork BirdCoder2 App API
info.description: Canonical BirdCoder2 multi-host registry and relayed agent conversation App API authority. The mobile H5 client registers hosts, issues pairing codes, and drives agent conversations that run on a Windows, Linux, macOS, Docker, or cloud sdkwork-sandbox host.

tags.name: hosts
tags.description: Owner-scoped host registry: listing, enrollment codes, and host administration.

tags.name: agent
tags.description: Agent conversations relayed to the host that runs the sdkwork-birdcoder2 instance.

get.description: List the hosts the authenticated user owns, newest first. Cursor paginated; the cursor is opaque and stable across pages.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

post.summary: Issue a pairing code for a new host
post.description: Creates a pending host and returns the pairing code the host runtime redeems on the Internal API to attach. The code is single-use and expires at expiresAt.

get.description: Returns one host the authenticated user owns, including its live lease state.

patch.summary: Rename, relabel, or administratively disable one host
patch.description: Partial update. Only the fields present in the body change. status accepts offline or disabled; online and pending are lifecycle-owned and rejected.

delete.description: Removes the host and every conversation it carried. The host runtime loses its lease immediately.

get.summary: List the conversations on one host
get.description: List the agent conversations hosted on one host, newest activity first. Cursor paginated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

post.summary: Open a conversation on one host
post.description: Opens an agent conversation bound to one host. Turns appended to it are claimed by that host's runtime.

get.description: Returns one conversation the authenticated user owns.

delete.description: Deletes the conversation together with its turns and event log.

get.summary: List the transcript of one conversation
get.description: List the turns of one conversation in ascending sequence order. Cursor paginated.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.

post.summary: Append a turn to one conversation
post.description: Enqueues a user turn for the host to claim. The turn starts in pending and moves through running to a terminal status.
Moves a pending or running turn to cancelled. A turn that already reached a terminal status is rejected.

get.summary: Read agent events after a sequence watermark
get.description: Returns the conversation's agent events whose sequence is strictly greater than after_sequence, in ascending order. nextCursor is the last delivered sequence, so a client resumes with after_sequence=nextCursor and never re-reads the transcript.

parameters.name: after_sequence
parameters.description: Exclusive watermark: return events with a strictly greater sequence.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return; default 20, maximum 99.

data.description: Operation-specific payload typed per response schema.

HostPlatform.description: Machine kind the host runs on.

HostStatus.description: Reachability of a host. pending: registered, no runtime attached. online: a runtime holds a live lease. offline: the lease lapsed or was closed. disabled: an operator disabled it.

HostAdministrativeStatus.description: The subset of host status an owner may set directly.

AgentTurnStatus.description: Delivery state of a turn. pending: enqueued, not yet claimed. running: claimed by the host. completed, failed, cancelled: terminal.

AgentEventKind.description: Kind of one agent event in a conversation log.

EpochSeconds.description: Instant in Unix epoch seconds. int64 crosses the wire as a string (API_SPEC section 13.6).

Sequence.description: Monotonic position inside a conversation. int64 crosses the wire as a string.

Host.description: One machine or runtime running a sdkwork-birdcoder2 instance.

HostEnrollment.description: A pairing code the owner hands to a host runtime.

AgentSession.description: One agent conversation bound to one host.

AgentTurn.description: One turn of a conversation, in ascending sequence order.

AgentEvent.description: One entry of a conversation's ordered agent event log.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload, passed through verbatim from the host runtime.

displayName.description: Name the host receives before it first attaches.

title.description: Conversation title; the platform supplies one when omitted.

content.description: Prompt text the host runtime hands to the agent.
